verdict.rationale: Brave Search API is a key-authenticated REST API called via plain HTTP or curl, so it runs headlessly by design (docs-1, docs-10, docs-66). It also ships an official MCP server and an n8n automation node for unattended workflows (docs-14, docs-15, probe-4). Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions examples, secret/env-var handling), a published OpenAPI spec (probe-3 found none), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
